items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: Madonna used to allow the families, if you have kids bring the wife and the kids. We’d get on a plane and we’d just go.

ctx.x: Your kids probably learned early on what the word “gig” meant. Yeah, dad’s got a gig tonight again.

Yeah, yeah. I missed – well listen I missed my son’s birth – my wife was early and I was in Vegas. Luckily I was in Vegas so I just got home immediately. But I was out there playing and she was like two weeks early. And I was going to come home like three days later and I got a phone call “Paging” – in those days they used to page people in the casinos you know, “Paging Luis Conte.” And my dad’s going “You just had a boy.” I go oh man. So there’s an example. I wish I would have been there, but they understand.…

After you did like a couple of hundred studio dates I’m guessing that you stopped reporting on every one of them when you got home. I mean here in Central New York we don’t – if you do a studio date it’s sort of an event. And you come home and sort of say, “Hey how did it go.” What would really make you bring this up, what your date was like today to your wife or your kids. This was significant? What kind of date?
